Name: Gaius (3 John)
Summary: Gaius was the wellbeloved recipient of John's third letter, commended because he walked in the truth and showed hospitality to travelling brethren. He is treated here as distinct from Gaius of Corinth, since the letters place them in different churches.
KeyStory: Gaius was the wellbeloved recipient of John's third letter, commended because he walked in the truth and showed hospitality to travelling brethren. He is treated here as distinct from Gaius of Corinth, since the letters place them in different churches.
LifeLesson: Hospitality to strangers is truth in action; supporting travellers speeds the gospel.
